label: Next bookmark
description: Select the next visible bookmark or URL.

label: Previous bookmark
description: Select the previous visible bookmark or URL.

label: Open selected bookmark
description: Open or switch to the selected bookmark or typed URL. In selection mode, toggle the bookmark.

label: Open subtree / new tab
description: Open a parent and its sub-pages. For a single bookmark or URL, open a new tab.

label: Always open a new tab
description: Open only the selected bookmark or URL in a new tab, including when it has sub-pages.

label: Expand sub-pages
description: Expand the selected parent when viewing the grouped list.

label: Collapse sub-pages
description: Collapse the selected parent when viewing the grouped list.

label: Collapse all
description: Clear search and collapse every group and sub-page in this view.

label: Collapse dock
description: Return to the compact search bar. Unsaved settings require confirmation.

label: Hide dock
description: Hide the window and clear private presentation. Escape remains available for hide and panic lock.

label: Use Firefox
description: Toggle the browser override for the next open.

label: Use Mullvad
description: Toggle the browser override for the next open.

label: Use Chrome
description: Toggle the browser override for the next open.

label: Use Edge
description: Toggle the browser override for the next open.
